records.source: No one really talks to me... I just come for the deviled eggs.
records.translation: Wala talagang kumakausap sa akin... pumupunta lang ako para sa mga pinalamang itlog.

records.source: Hey! How'd you get back here?$u#$b#Don't touch anything.
records.translation: Hoy! Paano ka nakapasok dito sa likuran?$u#$b#Huwag kang humawak ng anuman.

records.source: Abby's always loved the egg hunt, ever since she was a tiny girl.
records.translation: Mula noong napakabata pa niya, gustong-gusto na ni Abby ang paghahanap ng itlog.

records.source: I try to eat at least three eggs every day.#$e#I need that protein for my legs.
records.translation: Sinisikap kong kumain ng hindi bababa sa tatlong itlog araw-araw.#$e#Kailangan ng mga binti ko ang protinang iyon.

records.source: What's everyone so happy about? Hmmph...#$b#Eggs... why eggs?
records.translation: Bakit napakasaya ng lahat? Hmph...#$b#Mga itlog... bakit itlog?

records.source: This festival has been a tradition for as long as I can remember.#$b#Tradition connects us with both the past and the future... it's comforting.
records.translation: Tradisyon na ang pistang ito mula pa noong naaalaala ko.#$b#Pinag-uugnay tayo ng tradisyon sa nakaraan at sa hinaharap... nakapagpapanatag iyon.

records.source: Enjoying yourself, @?$h
records.translation: Nagsasaya ka ba, @?$h

records.source: Is there any more food?$s
records.translation: May pagkain pa ba?$s

records.source: The children have been looking forward to this festival for weeks.
records.translation: Ilang linggo nang inaasam ng mga bata ang pistang ito.

records.source: Hehe... I put something nice into the punch.$h#$e#Shhh... that's just between you and me, kid.
records.translation: Hehe... Nilagyan ko ng masarap na bagay ang punch.$h#$e#Shhh... sa ating dalawa lang iyon, bata.

records.source: I've been up since dawn coloring eggs... it's always my favorite part of the season.$h
records.translation: Mula pa bukang-liwayway akong nagkukulay ng mga itlog... lagi itong paborito kong bahagi ng panahon.$h

records.source: This festival is alright... but what I'm really looking forward to is the Flower Dance.
records.translation: Ayos lang ang pistang ito... pero ang talagang inaasam ko ay ang Sayaw ng mga Bulaklak.

records.source: Vincent loves this festival... it's a joy to see him so happy.
records.translation: Gustong-gusto ni Vincent ang pistang ito... kay sarap makita siyang napakasaya.

records.source: I'm not a big fan of eggs, to tell you the truth.
records.translation: Sa totoo lang, hindi ako gaanong mahilig sa itlog.

records.source: Even with my bad leg, I never miss a town festival.
records.translation: Kahit masama ang binti ko, hindi ako lumiliban sa mga pista ng bayan.

records.source: *sniff*... ub... my doze... allergies...$s
records.translation: *singhot*... ub... ang ilong bo... mga allergy...$s

records.source: Mmmm... This fruit punch is unusually good.$h
records.translation: Mmmm... Kakaibang sarap ng punch na prutas na ito.$h

records.source: Our hens have been working overtime to prepare for this festival.#$b#They deserve the best tonight... bowls full of sweet yellow corn!$h
records.translation: Walang tigil sa pagtatrabaho ang mga inahin natin para sa pistang ito.#$b#Karapat-dapat sila sa pinakamasarap ngayong gabi... mga mangkok na punô ng matamis at dilaw na mais!$h

records.source: Welcome to the Egg Festival... compliments of my wonderful brood of hens.
records.translation: Maligayang pagdating sa Pista ng Itlog... hatid ng kahanga-hanga kong kawan ng mga inahin.

records.source: Taking breaks from work can make you more productive in the long run.
records.translation: Mas magiging produktibo ka sa katagalan kung nagpapahinga ka paminsan-minsan.

records.source: I hope everyone's enjoying the food... I've been cooking for days to get everything ready.#$b#Fried eggs, boiled eggs, poached eggs, deviled eggs, scrambled eggs, chocolate eggs... you name it!$h
records.translation: Sana nasisiyahan ang lahat sa pagkain... Ilang araw akong nagluto para maihanda ang lahat.#$b#Pritong itlog, nilagang itlog, itlog na pinakuluang walang balat, pinalamang itlog, binating itlog, tsokolateng itlog... lahat na!$h

records.source: You say it's raining up above? *gasp*#$e#Rain... it's almost mythical to us. Some of us live our entire lives without ever experiencing it.
records.translation: Sabi mo, umuulan sa itaas? *napasinghap*#$e#Ulan... halos alamat lang iyon sa amin. Ang ilan sa amin ay nabubuhay nang hindi iyon nararanasan kailanman.

records.source: Hmm... And what about raw lizard egg sprinkled with blackened marrow?
records.translation: Hmm... At paano naman ang hilaw na itlog ng butiki na winisikan ng inihaw na utak ng buto?

records.source: Eggs definitely have a place in the well-balanced diet.#$e#Oops... I should take off my Doctor's hat for the time being.$11
records.translation: Talagang may lugar ang itlog sa balanseng pagkain.#$e#Ay... kailangan ko munang itabi ang pagiging doktor ko.$11

records.source: I heard it's raining back home. Is that why you came here?$h#$e#I kind of miss the rain, actually...$s
records.translation: Narinig kong umuulan sa inyo. Iyon ba ang dahilan kung bakit ka pumunta rito?$h#$e#Sa totoo lang, medyo hinahanap-hanap ko rin ang ulan...$s

records.source: I hope I can find some eggs before Vincent takes them all...$s
records.translation: Sana makahanap ako ng ilang itlog bago kunin lahat ni Vincent...$s

records.source: When does the egg hunt start?! I'm so excited!!$h
records.translation: Kailan magsisimula ang paghahanap ng itlog?! Sabik na sabik na ako!!$h

records.source: Sometimes I'll hide an egg too well and no one finds it...#$b#Well, until summer rolls around. Then the hot air starts to bring out the rotten smell... Hehe. $h
records.translation: Kung minsan, napakahusay ng pagtatago ko sa isang itlog kaya walang nakakikita nito...#$b#Hanggang sa dumating ang tag-init. Saka sisingaw sa init ang amoy ng pagkabulok... Hehe.$h
